note: Iron County park on the Turtle River between Lake of the Falls and the Turtle-Flambeau Flowage, with a boat landing. Three camping areas: the electric sites on Side 1, quieter lakeside sites with no electric on Side 2, and electric sites by the showers on Side 3. ATVs may ride to the campground on the paved road route from Trail 17. --Claude
summary: County page + rate sheet + map: $27 non-electric / $32 electric (tax included), ~May 1-Oct 15, 47 numbered sites (page table still says 32), Campspot booking from Jan 1, showers/flush/dump on Side 3. Riverfront -> riverview proposed (sites under continuous canopy). Phone and website changes flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> riverview (downgrade, for the reviewer): no site can be shown on open ground within ~50 m of the water. On Esri (leaf-on) and NAIP imagery every camping area sits under continuous forest canopy down to the shore. The closest pads are Side 2's sites 14 and 16 on the south edge of the Side 2 peninsula (about 46.1504,-90.1593, roughly 20-30 m from the water through a tree band) and Side 3's sites 25-32 along the river bank (about 46.1498,-90.1575, roughly 20-40 m through trees). The water there is the Turtle River/flowage, well over 30 m wide. The county calls Side 2's sites 'lakeside' and no site photo was read, so this is a canopy call, not a confirmed no-view; riverview because filtered water views from those sites are likely.
